jsonld.name: Paul's Italian Deli & Restaurant
jsonld.description: Family-run Italian deli in Kissimmee, FL serving New York style subs and sandwiches, with catering trays available for offices and private events.

script.es: El sabor de un deli de verdad.
script.en: The taste of a real deli.

parrafo.es: Paul's Italian Deli & Restaurant sirve subs y sandwiches estilo Nueva York en Kissimmee desde hace anos, con carnes Boar's Head y una receta familiar. Tambien armamos bandejas de catering para oficinas y eventos privados.
parrafo.en: Paul's Italian Deli & Restaurant has served New York style subs and sandwiches in Kissimmee for years, with Boar's Head meats and a family recipe. We also build catering trays for offices and private events.

hero.imagen_alt: Italian sub sandwich sliced in half, piled high with meats and toppings at Paul's Italian Deli

parrafo_1.es: Paul's Italian Deli & Restaurant es un deli familiar en Kissimmee que prepara subs y sandwiches estilo Nueva York con carnes Boar's Head. Ademas del mostrador, armamos bandejas de catering para oficinas, reuniones y eventos privados.
parrafo_1.en: Paul's Italian Deli & Restaurant is a family-run Italian deli in Kissimmee making New York style subs and sandwiches with Boar's Head meats. Beyond the counter, we also put together catering trays for offices, meetings and private events.

parrafo_2.es: Con mas de 1,200 reseñas en Google, los clientes repiten lo mismo: se sienten como en casa, el servicio es rapido y amable, y tres generaciones de la misma familia siguen trabajando detras del mostrador.
parrafo_2.en: With over 1,200 reviews on Google, customers say the same thing again and again: it feels like home, the service is fast and friendly, and three generations of the same family still work behind the counter.

texto.es: Llama para pedir o pasa directo al mostrador de lunes a sabado, de 10am a 3pm.
texto.en: Call ahead or walk straight up to the counter Monday through Saturday, 10am to 3pm.

texto.es: El equipo te recomienda el corte y los toppings, con carnes Boar's Head siempre frescas.
texto.en: The team can recommend cuts and toppings, with Boar's Head meats always fresh.

texto.es: Si necesitas bandejas de catering, nos cuentas el numero de personas y armamos tu pedido.
texto.en: If you need catering trays, tell us the headcount and we will put your order together.

texto.es: Tu pedido sale fresco y listo, igual si es un sub o una bandeja completa.
texto.en: Your order comes out fresh and ready, whether it's a single sub or a full tray.

nota.es: Las bandejas de catering se cotizan segun el numero de personas. Llama y te da un precio claro.
nota.en: Catering trays are quoted based on headcount. Call and get a clear price.

texto.es: Nuestro clasico Italian Hero con carnes Boar's Head, queso y toppings frescos.
texto.en: Our classic Italian Hero with Boar's Head meats, cheese and fresh toppings.

texto.es: Bandejas de sandwiches surtidos para reuniones de oficina y eventos pequenos.
texto.en: Assorted sandwich trays for office meetings and small events.

texto.es: Roast beef, salchicha con pimientos y mas opciones, calientes o frias.
texto.en: Roast beef, sausage and peppers, and more, served hot or cold.

texto.es: El toque dulce para cerrar tu pedido, hecho en casa.
texto.en: The sweet finish to your order, made in house.

pie.es: ¿Necesitas algo para un grupo grande? Llamanos igual, armamos bandejas a la medida de tu evento.
pie.en: Need something for a larger group? Call us anyway, we build trays to fit your event.

subtitulo.en: A 4.9 rating and over 1,200 Google reviews back up our sandwiches.

items.quote: Took the girls for sandwiches. Haven't been in 29 years. We ate Italian Hero, roast beef and sausage w/ onions and peppers. All were 5 star. Great family and still kicking butt!!!!

To all my north easterns here in Central Florida this is definitely a must try. Reminds me of home. I got the italian with fresh mozzarella and it was great! Meats were fresh and the staff was very friendly. Very hard to find a good sub shop like this.

Best sub I've ever had. I really don't like sandwiches but the family picked it. I could eat these subs everyday. The ham with the works was the best. They were very friendly and helped course the best sandwiches. The tiramisu was super yummy.
